name: resistance band weighted standing pronation twist curl (arm wrestler)
description: A curl that adds a forearm twist, mimicking arm wrestling to build the biceps and forearms.
instructions: Stand on a resistance band and hold the handle with your palm turned to the side.
Curl the handle up while rotating your wrist.
Finish with your palm facing you and the biceps squeezed.
Lower slowly and untwist back to the start.
Keep your elbow tucked. Finish the reps, then switch arms.
